Issue Title: feat(powershell): add powershell-based tool for windows os Description: ### Discussed in https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope/discussions/2125
Originally posted by **Liripo** July 19, 2026 有什么好的方式能自动识别 windowns环境, 工具执行时自动使用powershell的命令
**Background** AgentScope currently lacks native support for PowerShell as a tool-building environment. Now that AgentScope 2.0 has entered a stable development phase, it is a good time to start considering and implementing PowerShell-based tooling support, enabling broader accessibility for Windows-native developers and workflows. **Open Questions** Since all tools in AgentScope rely on the `BackendBase` class for backend switching, and currently only `LocalBackend` is implemented, we need to determine the best approach for supporting Windows/PowerShell. Specifically: - Should we introduce a new `LocalWindowsBackend` as a dedicated Windows backend? - Should we handle platform differences within the existing `LocalBackend` by detecting the current OS at runtime? - Or should `LocalBackend` be refactored to support cross-platform execution through a unified interface? **Changes** - [TBD] Modify or introduce a new backend to support Windows, depending on the decision made in the Open Questions above - Implement a PowerShell tool by subclassing `ToolBase` - Update the `list_tools` interface in `LocalWorkspace` to return either PowerShell or Bash tools based on the current operating system > **Note:** The above changes should only be planned and implemented **after** the open questions have been resolved.
